description: Ruth Kelleher has received a call from Marian Prowse about the deposit deadline. Ruth is aware that the deposit must be in Marian's account by end of Wednesday 16th September. Ruth has not yet paid the deposit herself and is waiting to see how the group will handle it.
Dev Sandhu has expressed enthusiasm for the trip twice in the thread but has not yet paid any deposit. He is aware of the deadline.
Nina Achebe has not replied to the thread about the trip. She is aware of the deposit requirement but has not communicated her decision.
Marian Prowse is holding the week for the group until end of Wednesday 16th September. She has not yet received any deposit.
Ruth sends a message to the group chat with Dev and Nina reminding them of the Wednesday deadline and asking how to handle the £600 deposit.
The message from Ruth arrives on Dev's phone and appears as a notification on his lock screen.
The message from Ruth arrives on Nina's phone and appears as a notification on her lock screen, but she does not see it because she is occupied with her mother.

Ruth sends a follow-up message to the group chat with Dev and Nina: 'Hi both, just following up on the cottage deposit – deadline is end of Wednesday. Can we sort out who's paying what? I really don't want to lose the booking. Let me know ASAP.'
The follow-up message from Ruth arrives on Dev's phone and appears as a notification on his lock screen, alongside the earlier notification.
Dev glances at his phone during a brief break and sees the two notifications from Ruth on the lock screen.

Dev sends a message to the group chat: 'Hey Ruth, I'm still keen for the trip but I can't do the deposit until payday on the 28th. If that's too late and you need to fill my spot, I understand. Let me know.'
Nina's phone remains in her bag, notifications unseen, as she continues attending to her mother.
Ruth's call rings on Dev's phone.
Ruth's call rings on Dev's phone, but Dev is busy at work and does not answer; the call goes to voicemail after a few rings.
Dev's phone shows a voicemail notification from Ruth, but Dev is occupied with work and does not notice it.
Marian crosses out the hold for the group in her paper diary and marks the week as available again.
Marian calls the couple from Leeds to offer them the week.
